value.rationale: Early-time spreading from a minimum affinely spanning seed is a natural kinetic invariant not fixed by its eventual span. The theorem classifies every reachable point in ten nontrivial affine-coordinate orbits, gives all-dimensional polynomial counts and resolves a sharp three-round threshold with an explicit six-point missing orbit at dimension five. Unlike a routine cardinality substitution, this uses and exposes previously unrecorded pair-type combinatorics.
